core_obligations: Identify the dualised module as a product of copies of the dual of the ring indexed by the dual of the source module (proof lines 13834-13836).
Reduce to injectivity of the dual of the ring by the injectivity of products (proof lines 13836-13838).
Compute the module of maps into that dual as the Pontryagin dual of the source and apply exactness of the duality functor of the same block to conclude (proof lines 13838-13845).
proof_roadmap: Rewrite as a product of copies of the dual of the ring (proof lines 13834-13836).
Reduce to the single dual module (proof lines 13836-13838).
Use the adjunction and exactness (proof lines 13838-13846).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the module constructed by dualising a module with respect to the Pontryagin dual of the ring is injective, and the proof is a 12-line argument in two reductions. It first identifies the module as a product of copies of the dual of the ring, so that it suffices to prove injectivity of that single module, and then computes the module of homomorphisms into it as the Pontryagin dual of the source, concluding with the exactness of the duality functor proved in the same block. The identification as a product and the adjunction computation are the two steps, and both are displayed.
